(developer), version, default home screen, initial release date, latest release version and date, platforms (list of devices), kernel type, license, preceded by iOS 9, succeeded by iOS 11, official website, support status.

We need subject_type and object_type. Use generic types: software, organization, date, version, device, kernel, license, website, support status.

We must produce list of dictionaries.

Let's parse:

- Subject: iOS 10 (software). Relation: instance of? Not needed. But we can have "developer": Apple Inc. relation: "developer". object_type: organization.

- "Source model": "Closed with open-source components". Might be relation "source model". object: "Closed with open-source components". object_type: "source model". Could be.

- "Initial release": September 13, 2016. relation: "initial release". object: date.

- "Latest release": 10.3.3 (14G60) on July 19, 2017. Could be two facts: latest release version and point in time qualifier. So relation: "latest release". object: "10.3.3 (14G60)". qualifier point in time: "July 19, 2017". object_type: version.

- "Platforms": list of devices. For each device, relation: "platform". object: device name. Could be many triplets.

- "Kernel type": Hybrid (XNU). relation: "kernel type". object: "Hybrid (XNU)". object_type: kernel.

- "License": Proprietary software with open-source components. relation: "license". object: that phrase. object_type: license.

- "Preceded by": iOS 9. relation: "preceded by". object: iOS 9. object_type: software.

- "Succeeded by": iOS 11. relation: "succeeded by". object: iOS 11.

- "Official website": iOS 10 at the Wayback Machine (archived September 12, 2017). relation: "official website". object: "iOS 10 at the Wayback Machine". object_type: website. Could add qualifier "archived date": September 12, 2017.

- "Support status": Third-party application support only. relation: "support status". object: "Third-party application support only". object_type: support status.

- "Default iOS 10 home screen on an iPhone 7" maybe relation: "default home screen". object: "iPhone 7". Not sure.

- "Developer Apple Inc." Already captured.

- "iOS 10 A version of the iOS operating system". Could have relation: "instance of" or "subclass of". Might be "instance of" software. But not required.

We need subject_type for iOS 10: "software". object_type accordingly.

Now produce JSON.

Make sure qualifiers list for each triplet.

For platforms, no qualifiers.

For latest release, qualifier point in time.

For official website, qualifier "archived date"? Use relation "archived date". object date.

Now produce.
